crossRefs.note: They sat before him, the firstborn according to his birthright, and the youngest according to his youth, and the men…
We said, ‘We can’t go down. If our youngest brother is with us, then we will go down: for we may not see the man’s…
Jacob, their father, said to them, “You have bereaved me of my children! Joseph is no more, Simeon is no more, and you…
May God Almighty give you mercy before the man, that he may release to you your other brother and Benjamin. If I am…

people.name: Benjamin
people.line: Youngest son of Jacob and Rachel

translations.web: He searched, beginning with the oldest, and ending at the youngest. The cup was found in Benjamin’s sack.
translations.bsb: The steward searched, beginning with the oldest and ending with the youngest—and the cup was found in Benjamin’s sack.
translations.kjv: And he searched, and began at the eldest, and left at the youngest: and the cup was found in Benjamin's sack.
translations.asv: And he searched, and began at the eldest, and left off at the youngest: and the cup was found in Benjamin's sack.
